scope: Settle an existing native confirmation even if an earlier approved call has resolved target selection and current policy no longer requests a dialog.
baseline: Two synthetic calls both completed, but the second decided confirmation remained at the queue head; bounded regression failed before the fix.
fixed: Every resumed response settles its exact bound approval once. Target, tool arguments, preview, terminal generation/version, expiry, accepted value and single-use checks remain. Policy hash may differ only when current policy already authorizes the call without any new confirmation.
guards: A changed target fingerprint blocks the second effect.
Rejecting the second confirmation produces no second effect.
Concurrent duplicate decisions produce exactly one accepted effect.
Parallel and successive confirmation queues both finish without orphaned actionable approvals.

frontend.duplicateClick: Successful submission remains disabled until the pending ID advances.
frontend.decisionConflict: Refresh current state on failure; do not automatically retry an approval.
frontend.lateError: An old decision error cannot overwrite the next approval card.

existingUserOperation: Inspected existing exit-code-0 command evidence only; did not approve, replay or mutate its operation record.
release: Mac Dev updated with this fix and prior PR #19/#20 fixes; formal release unchanged.
